postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Morocco case study defines five digits: the first digit is a postal routeing zone, the first two digits identify a province, and the remaining numerical series identifies a sector, Barid Al-Maghrib agency or centre, or large-volume recipient. The fifth digit is a mandatory type discriminator; syntax or a directory hit remains text assignment evidence and does not by itself prove polygon membership.
postal_system.type_rule: Codes ending 0, 1, 7 or 8 are home-delivery sector codes; a sector may be a whole locality, a district or a group of districts. Endings 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 identify Barid Al-Maghrib agencies or centres for P.O. box or counter delivery. Ending 9 identifies a large-volume recipient. Agency, P.O. box and recipient codes are non-area by default.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Canonical postal geometry requires an exact official rights-cleared Barid Al-Maghrib surface for the same code, code type, edition and validity. A home-delivery sector may support an optional derived non-canonical surface from permitted address points, roads, buildings and locality evidence. Office coordinates, administrative boundaries, interpolation, Voronoi and model output never become official postal polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Building number, street, neighbourhood, locality, commune, province or prefecture, postcode, agency, P.O. Box and recipient code remain typed evidence. A sector, office, P.O. Box or large-volume-recipient code does not identify an occupant, owner, exact entrance or exact building footprint.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires rights-cleared authoritative building geometry and a source-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk to the exact civic address. Postal containment, cadastral overlap, street-text match, nearest building, office proximity or sector membership creates candidates only.
postal_system.administration_rule: Region, province or prefecture and commune geometry remains administrative or cartographic context. The UPU coding hierarchy and ANCFCC administrative maps do not make an administrative boundary a postal sector unless Barid Al-Maghrib explicitly publishes that relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: The Morocco Open Data portal applies its ODbL-derived licence only to the exact listed dataset and edition. Codepostal search access, a downloadable directory, government authorship, public viewing, ANCFCC ordering or cadastral consultation never by themselves grant bulk extraction or repository redistribution. Every artifact pins owner, dataset, licence, attribution, share-alike duties, edition, coverage, schema, CRS and digest.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, contacts, correspondence, shipment records, query history, P.O. Box holders, large-volume account holders, residents, occupants, owners, tenants, title and cadastral rights are excluded from public artifacts.
postal_system.crs_rule: Every spatial artifact retains its source CRS, axis order, zone, epoch and accuracy. Merchich, Lambert or product-specific coordinates are never relabelled WGS84. EPSG:4326 output requires a reviewed transform, zone selection and accuracy statement.
postal_system.territory_rule: The repository uses ISO code MA and exact source-stated coverage. MA and EH remain distinct country or territory packs; postal, open-data, administrative or cartographic coverage is not used to decide sovereignty, jurisdiction or borders, and gaps are not model-filled as official.
postal_system.freshness_rule: Postal sector, agency, recipient, office-coordinate, address, administrative, cadastral, building and licence artifacts refresh independently. The public open-data postcode lists identify a September 2018 update and must not be represented as current without a newer pinned operator record. Mixed-edition joins fail closed unless validity, known-time and explicit relation overlap.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> official sector surface or permitted civic-address point -> typed five-digit candidate -> locality/commune/province-or-prefecture/region -> explicit address-building relation -> MA AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical five digits -> fifth-digit delivery type -> pinned Barid Al-Maghrib assignment -> official surface or non-area record -> optional derived home-delivery-sector surface -> explicit civic-address/building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: source-defined stable address-building relation, common identifier, or reviewed explicit crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: Exactly five digits remain text; prefixes, punctuation and four- or six-digit values are rejected.
The fifth digit selects home-delivery sector, agency/centre, or large-volume-recipient semantics before geometry is considered.
Barid Al-Maghrib assignment and geometry authority are recorded independently.
Only eligible home-delivery sector codes may receive derived surfaces; inputs, method, uncertainty, exclusions, topology, version, time and digest are recorded and output remains non-canonical.
Exact building output has an authoritative relation or reviewed crosswalk; containment, text and proximity alone never pass.
Dataset-specific licence, ODbL duties where applicable, source CRS, zone, transform, attribution and redistribution conditions are pinned.
MA and EH are not silently merged and no recipient, holder, resident, owner, title, correspondence or query data is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
A complete rights-cleared typed five-digit assignment passes authority, coverage, freshness, licence and digest gates.
Official or derived sector geometry and public address artifacts pass type, authority, uncertainty, privacy, CRS, validity and redistribution gates.
Exact permitted building geometry and explicit civic-address joins pass identifier, ambiguity, privacy and quality gates.
